description: Sourced, segmented SaaS growth benchmarks shared by every skill. See README.md in this folder for the schema, how to pick a segment, and the list of hard-coded thresholds to migrate.
freshness_rule: A row older than 6 months (by verified_on) must be re-checked with WebSearch/WebFetch before it is quoted; always cite source_name and year next to the number.

conventions.percentiles: p25/median/p75/p90 are percentiles of the metric's own distribution. For lower_is_better metrics the best quartile is at or below p25.
conventions.mean: Arithmetic average as reported by the source.
conventions.value: A single reported figure whose statistic the source does not name (or a segment value from a table).
conventions.thresholds: Rule-of-thumb bands from a named practitioner; not a distribution. Each band has label and optional min/max (min inclusive, max exclusive).

periods.cohort: share of a signup cohort within a window (see window)
periods.point_in_time: rate or snapshot without a retention period

conventions.segment: motion, arr_band, acv_band and pricing_model are 'all' when not segmented; ai_native is true, false, 'mixed' (sample blends both) or null (not reported); extra holds any other cut.
